name: aluminum acetate
uses: Uses • Insects Bites • Minor Burn • Athlete's foot • Poison lvy • Poison oak • Poison sumac • Rashes cause by soaps, detergents, cosmetic or jewelry
otcwarn: Warnings ■ For external use only. ■ Avoid contact with eyes. ■ Do not apply to open wounds. ■ STOP USE and ask a doctor if condition worsens or symptoms persist for more than seven days. ■ Keep out of reach of children.
